svg.title: Token Usage Dashboard Mobile — telemetry
svg.desc: Mobile token usage telemetry: 74.7B tokens, 94.2% cache hit, $68,858.01 estimated cost, peak 5.8B on 06-06. Pure SVG SMIL animation.
